newsitem.title: USA: Elek-Tek says talks with Bookcase end.
newsitem.headline: Elek-Tek says talks with Bookcase end.

text.p: Elek-Tek Inc said Friday that talks with Bookcase Investments Llc, a Chicago-based investment group, have ended, and it was exploring options to strengthen the company's financial position.

The talks with Bookcase fell apart after the prospective investor was unable to satisfy certain conditions specified in its letter of intent, including reaching agreement with the Elek-Tek's two largest stockholders who were to retain interests in the company.
